answers.valueEn: Signs of front accident, front section replaced, core and two chassis members painted, paint in engine bay. Impact in internal torpedo core, rust, cuts in insulation, and cracks in strut tower seams especially left. Broken front-left light and upper grille. Broken windshield. Signs of strong rear-left impact in light pocket, inner fender, and rear panel; heat marks and welding on rear panel. Cut in rear metal wheel well on the left and right sill end. No rear bumper chassis. Non-original rear light lenses. Modified rims. Welding in exhaust spring. Broken timing cover plastic. Engine lifters tapping sound. Broken rear-left fender liner. Heavy second gear shift. Complete car repaint including roof with heavy filler and cracking in filler especially on roof, trunk, hood, and pillars.
